prompt:
Scene:
A square color magazine advertisement illustration, medium close-up on the front of the teardrop turquoise refrigerator from the reference kitchen, with the door open. Camera is head-on, eye-level. Warm ad-lit studio lighting matches the reference, with halftone grain and gentle offset print feel.

Subject:
The same teardrop-shaped turquoise refrigerator established in the reference, shown with its single rounded chrome spaceship-style handle pulled wide open. Inside: chrome wire shelves, a glass bottle of whole milk with a pleated foil cap, a bowl of plump red cherries, a block of bright-yellow cheese, a jar of green olives, a small turquoise plate of cold cuts, and at the top shelf a round glass bowl of bright-red jello with cream on top. The interior is softly lit with a warm incandescent glow and a small amber interior light is visible. A sliver of ivory laminate counter and boomerang wallpaper remain at frame edges to tie back to the reference.

Important details:
Preserve the exact teardrop body shape, turquoise enamel shade, chrome handle form, and side profile proportions from the reference. Fridge interior must feel like a 1958 ad of a well-stocked modern icebox: glass bottles not plastic, foil-capped milk, primary-color food items. Keep halftone grain and slight CMYK offset on red items. Overall palette locked to ivory, turquoise, cadmium red, bright yellow, powder pink, chrome.

Use case:
Turquoise Kitchen Set series shot 4 of 4, a product-detail moment showing the hero appliance from the reference in an open-door beauty shot.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no plastic milk jugs, no modern barcodes, no LCD display, no photoreal skin, no modern minimalist fridge design, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, preserve the reference fridge form.
